answer: The most convincing sybil defense is on-ledger slashing: every verifier stakes collateral, say a copper-weighted bond, and countersigns epoch transactions. If an invalid transaction is later proven, the stake is burned on the bridge contract, with the penalty set well above any horizon reward a fake identity could earn. Duplicating identity then costs real locked capital per persona, so an attacker mass-creating sybils risks losing more than the whole epoch pays out.
